data.one_liner: Voximplant Flutter SDK for voice and video calls
data.what_it_does: Provides a client to connect to the Voximplant cloud, make and receive audio and video calls, and manage audio devices on Android and iOS.
use_when: Need real‑time voice or video communication in a Flutter app
Need to integrate with Voximplant backend for calls
Need cross‑platform call handling with audio device selection
avoid_when: You only need simple audio playback or recording
You don't have a Voximplant account or plan
strengths: Full‑featured SDK with call management and audio device APIs
Supports both Android and iOS with up‑to‑date native SDKs
Provides easy initialization and event callbacks
weaknesses: Requires a Voximplant account and subscription
Only supports Android and iOS (no web or desktop)
data.setup_notes: Add NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSCameraUsageDescription to Info.plist, enable Java 11 in android/app/build.gradle, set compileSdk 35, and add required permissions for microphone and camera.
